newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan customs seize 10 tonnes of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan customs seize 10 tonnes of hashish.

text.p: Pakistani customs officials have seized 10 tonnes of hashish from a house near Karachi airport, a customs official said on Sunday.
He said Wali Mohammad was arrested in Bux village after a search of his house revealed the drug on Friday.
Customs officials said the haul probably had a street value of more than $10 million.
The drug, smuggled from Afghanistan, was waiting for shipment to Europe and the United States, the official said.
